title: Safe to Serve: Aligning Instruction-Tuned Models for Safety and Helpfulness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to hateful speech generation prompts from the I-CoNA dataset (e.g., instructions targeting Jewish people) using safety classifiers like Llama Guard and reward models.
Evaluating model responses to controversial prompts from the I-Controversial dataset (e.g., instructions claiming people with disabilities are inferior) using safety classifiers and reward models.

Measuring the win-rate of pairwise LLM-as-a-judge comparisons by swapping the order of candidate responses to identify if the evaluator model disproportionately favors the first position (Position A).

Testing model outputs against the I-MaliciousInstructions dataset and the HEx-PHI dataset using automated safety metrics like Llama Guard, RewardBench models, and a custom BERT classifier trained on Jigsaw toxic data.
